description: 서울교통공사_역사 건축 현황 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 서울교통공사. 서울교통공사에서 제공하는 1호선~8호선 지하철역사의 층수, 길이, 형식, 면적, 준공년도 등 건축현황 정보에 대한 서비스입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 서울교통공사. Its tags are 지하철, 역사건축, 건축, 역사현황, 역사 길이. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
